{{Quote|We had gotten stuck on Hethar, checking out a small Imperial contingent there.|[[Homack]]|<ref name="Gear" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Homack]] and several other [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] went on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hethar]] in order to investigate a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] contingent. During their mission, the Rebels were attacked by [[shredder bat]]s.
